the structure of ownership of Serbian corporations, in terms of the concentration of property, does not significantly influence corporate performance.
the ownership structure of companies is an important determinant of the performance of the companies, and in particular, that the companies with dispersed ownership are the least efficient.
the concentration of ownership in the Serbian economy is very high, and it has a negative impact on corporate performance.

the question: What ownership structure of the corporation has the most significant impact on its performance?
the relationship between ownership structure and the market value of the corporation.
the relationship between corporate ownership structure and corporate performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the ownership structure of the corporation, in the case of the Serbian capital market, does not have a significant impact on corporate performance.
the ownership structure of the corporation, expressed by a number of indicators, has a significant influence on corporate performance.
the structure of ownership of a corporation is one of the main factors of the corporate performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the concentration of ownership in the corporation is the main indicator of its performance, which is expressed through the value of Tobin's Q.
the ownership structure is one of the most important factors in the corporate performance.
the concentration of ownership is not a sufficient condition for the success of corporate operations, but it is a necessary condition.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the structure of the property of the corporation, in the sense of the degree of dispersion, has an impact on the corporate performance.

the concentration of property ownership in the form of the largest shareholders, as well as the concentration of ownership in the form that is expressed through the ultimate owner of the company, is a significant indicator of the corporate performance.
the concentration of ownership in the form of a small number of shareholders is a prerequisite for a better performance of the corporations.
